title: Apply the owner-approved GitHub ruleset and safe non-merging probes

spec.identity: GitHub CLI authenticated as krnese for the explicitly approved 2026-09-24 governance task
spec.boundary: GitHub REST API for krnese/golden-path only: create the exact Golden Path main ruleset approved in adr-github-governance-controls after fresh checks; read back the ruleset and effective main rules; create synthetic fixture commits, one isolated governance-probe topic branch and a non-merging probe PR; fast-forward only that probe branch for the recovery case; close the probe without merging. No change to main contents, other settings, other repositories, collaborators or bypass; no live destructive probe, integration of the local diff or physical deployment adapter. This is a finite task-scoped boundary, not standing autonomous administration.

authorization.principal: Accountable owner explicitly approving this transition in the 2026-09-24T14:03:05.767+02:00 user message
authorization.scope: The selected ruleset fields and previously defined safe PR-based CI probes only; all repository integration remains with the owner.
authorization.enforcement: Explicit human task approval plus tool confirmation; commands bind the exact repository, main base SHA, verified check publisher and probe ref. GitHub enforces authenticated repository permissions and installed rules. Fresh read-before-write and exact post-write comparison detect drift. Bounded requests have no automatic mutation retries; re-read after ambiguous outcomes. The API does not authenticate the human approval statement or distinguish human and agent use of shared owner credentials.
authorization.deniedBehavior: Stop without the requested mutation when identity, scope, approval or preconditions are absent or mismatched. Preserve API errors and partial success; no implicit alternate identity, privilege escalation, bypass, merge, rollback or weakening of controls.
